game.title: Armored Core VI: Fires of Rubicon
game.blurb: Mech action game in which a mercenary pilot takes missions on the planet Rubicon, from FromSoftware, released 2023-08-25. RAWG average playtime: 11 hours. Genre: Action. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: Missions and Endings

chapters.title: Parts and Logs
chapters.summary: Collecting every weapon, external part, internal part and expansion, plus the combat logs and data logs.

chapters.title: Building Your AC
chapters.summary: Assembling and tuning your AC, upgrading its OS, painting it, and the all-achievements goal.

attribution: Achievement data from Steam (Steam Web API, app 1888160)
StrategyWiki: no usable walkthrough, nothing used — https://strategywiki.org/wiki/Armored_Core_VI:_Fires_of_Rubicon
Fandom (armoredcore.fandom.com, CC BY-SA): page names only were checked to confirm structure; no text copied — https://armoredcore.fandom.com/wiki/ARMORED_CORE_VI_FIRES_OF_RUBICON
notes: Backlog game, picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year (docs/PLAN.md section 2 ordering). StrategyWiki has a stub page (completion stage 0); its Walkthrough and Gameplay subpages are linked but not written, and the only written subpages are "Achievements and trophies", "Controls" and "Table of Contents", so nothing was used. armoredcore.fandom.com answers the API under the title "ARMORED CORE VI FIRES OF RUBICON" (the shorter title gave no page), with about 253 linked pages, including subpages "Missions", "Arena", "Endings", "Parts" and "New Game Plus"; names only were looked at, nothing copied. 26 of 30 Steam achievements are hidden, with no descriptions. Six hidden ones were placed by their names alone: "Master of Arena" in The Arena, the five ending in "Collector" in Parts and Logs, and "Tuning Expert" in Building Your AC; the rest, including "Asset Holder", sit in Missions and Endings as a placeholder. Only 4 chapters, because the visible achievements cover few themes.
